lines.opener: *a three-headed king lounges on the back of a dragon; the bull's head bellows, the ram's head sneers, and the man's head, in the middle, smiles* Well, well. A sweet mortal, all alone in the dark. Did you come bareheaded, as you ought?
lines.openerHostile: *flames curl out of the man's mouth; the bull's head lowers its horns* You come armed, mortal? How very brave. *the ram's head laughs* How very short.
lines.like: *the man's head smiles slowly; the bull's head snorts approval* Oh, I like that. Go on.
lines.dislike: *all three heads scowl at once* Careful, sweet mortal. Careful.
lines.hate: *all three heads gag* That SMELL! Not again, not again! *the dragon wheels and they are gone, south, toward Egypt*
lines.flirt: *the man's head raises an eyebrow and smiles; the bull's head winks; the ram's head rolls its eyes* Bold. I like bold. So tell me, sweet mortal: top or bottom? *the ram's head groans*
lines.join: *the man's head laughs, delighted* Very well. I'll ride with you a while, sweet mortal. *the ram's head mutters* We'll regret this. *the bull's head* WINE.
lines.demand: *the bull's head bellows* WINE. *the man's head, smoothly* What my colleague means is: a little wine would be most welcome.
lines.gift: *he slides a ring off one of his fingers and drops it into your palm* A ring of virtues. Don't ask which ones. *the ram's head snickers*
lines.thanks: *the bull's head drains it in one swallow* AH. *the man's head* Exquisite. You have taste.
lines.letPass: *the dragon shifts aside* Go on, then. *the man's head laughs at something only he can see* You'll find out.
lines.neutral: *the man's head examines his nails while the bull's head chews and the ram's head yawns*
lines.ai: *the man's head laughs* An 'A-I'? Sweet mortal, I've been called every name in Hell, and that is the dullest.
lines.refuseJoin: *all three heads laugh* ASK a king? Oh, no. Kings are begged, sweet mortal, and then they decide.
lines.refuse: *the ram's head* No. *the man's head* What he said.
lines.leaveNow: *the man's head sighs* You bore all three of us. That takes talent. *the dragon spreads its wings*
